referenceCostHelp: Uses the current administrator-managed WeightPilot reference prices and existing 6, 12 or 16 month projection. This is illustrative, not a pharmacy quote or offer.
pharmacyEstimateHelp: Optionally include one saved source-listed price for a specific treatment strength and period. It is a dated reference, not a live or guaranteed price, recommendation or dose assessment. It is kept separate from the multi-month WeightPilot projection because the dose and period are not directly comparable.
legacyPharmacyEstimate: Existing saved reference retained: {source}, {price}. Choose a saved entry or untick to remove it.
notComparable: This older draft has both types of estimate saved. Because the periods and strength basis are not comparable, the pharmacy reference is omitted from the email preview until you choose one cost option.
